background_setting: An urban city street on a clear sunny day, lined with mid-rise buildings, storefronts, and parked cars along the curbs. The ego lane ahead is under reconstruction, blocked by a rectangle of freshly poured wet concrete bordered by wooden forms and orange cones, with a road worker attending to it. The adjacent lane to the left remains open and clear, allowing other traffic to pass. Sidewalks flank both sides, with occasional pedestrians and street trees casting consistent hard shadows.

lighting.direction: Sunlight from upper right, front-side lit
lighting.shadows: Consistent hard-edged shadows cast to the left of objects, including cones, worker, and forms
lighting.illumination_effect: Crisp high-contrast illumination that makes the wet concrete glisten with specular reflections and keeps details sharp

aesthetics.composition: Ego-perspective centered on the road ahead, with the concrete rectangle dominating the lower-center frame, open lane to the left, and buildings receding toward a vanishing point
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neutral greys of concrete and asphalt punctuated by vivid safety orange cones and vest, with muted urban building tones and blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating row of orange cones and linear wooden forms along the slab edge

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the wet concrete and construction zone ahead

context: Autonomous vehicle perception scenario recognizing a closed, unsafe road surface and stopping

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward down the city street, approaching the construction zone ahead.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
The vehicle brakes to a full stop just before the wet concrete and remains completely stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Black text on orange diamond warning sign, bold sans-serif
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Mounted on a stand at the right edge of the closed lane, visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Warns drivers of the construction and lane closure ahead

segments.description: Ego vehicle drives forward on the clear city street toward the visible construction zone.
segments.key_changes: Construction zone grows larger in frame as vehicle advances.
segments.camera: Smooth forward motion at steady speed.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: Vehicle comes to a complete stop before the wet concrete and holds position. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels forward down the city street, approaching the construction zone ahead. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient urban daytime sounds: distant city traffic, the low hum of the ego vehicle's engine tapering off, the soft squeal and settling of brakes as the car stops, faint scraping of the worker's trowel against wet concrete, and occasional distant construction noise. No dialogue or music.
